text: Hi Priya, thanks for sending the quarterly report. I went through it last night and overall it looks good. Could you update the revenue chart on page 4 and send me the final version by Friday? Let's also schedule a quick call with Rahul and Aranya next Tuesday at 3.30
I pushed the changes to the main branch but the Kubernetes deployment is still failing. The API returned a JSON response with a 404 status code when the user is not found.
I think we should refactor the authentication module, adding new features and also need better logging in the payment services.

Please book two train tickets from Kolkata to Bangalore for the 21st of November. My flight lands at 7.45 in the morning so I will be joining the stand-up a bit late. Our revenue grew by 18% this quarter and the temperature today is around 32 degrees Celsius.
with a chance of heavy rain in the evening.

Remind me to buy milk, egg, bread and a dozen banana on the way home. Honestly, the new model runs entirely on CPU and does not need dedicated graphics card. Which is pretty impressive. We should compare Whisper, Paratic and 11labs on accuracy, speed and privacy. Thank you for your help. Let me know if you have any questions.
